user.title: Connect to LubeLogger
user.description: Create an API key in LubeLogger (Settings → API Keys) with the **Editor** role. A Viewer key can read reminders but cannot add odometer records.

data_description.url: The address you open LubeLogger at in the browser, including the port.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to LubeLogger at this URL.
error.unknown: Unexpected response from LubeLogger. Check the URL and the server version.

abort.already_configured: This LubeLogger server is already configured.

vehicle.title: Vehicle
vehicle.description: Choose the vehicle to configure. Vehicles marked ✓ already have an odometer source.

source.title: Odometer source – {vehicle}
source.description:
LubeLogger currently has **{odometer}** for this vehicle.

Pick an entity (a sensor, or a device tracker such as Traccar – you choose the attribute in the next step) **or** write a template. Leave both empty to stop syncing this vehicle.

data_description.entity_id: Its state, or one of its attributes, holds the odometer value.
data_description.template: Must render the final odometer number (no multiplier or offset is applied). See the README for an example.

entity.title: Odometer source – {vehicle}
entity.description:
Source: `{entity}`

Value with the suggested settings: **{preview}** — LubeLogger currently has: **{odometer}**.

Odometer = value × multiplier + offset.

data_description.attribute: Leave empty to use the state of the entity. Traccar: totalDistance.
data_description.multiplier: 0.001 converts metres (Traccar) to kilometres; 0.000621371 converts metres to miles.
data_description.offset: Added after multiplying, to correct the difference between the GPS distance and the real dashboard odometer.

data.notes: Note written on each odometer record

data_description.max_increase: A sync that would raise the odometer by more than this is rejected, protecting against a wrong multiplier or a faulty source. 0 disables the check.

error.template_not_number: The template does not currently render a number.

abort.no_vehicles: No vehicles were found in LubeLogger.

sync_odometer.name: Sync odometer
sync_odometer.description: Reads the configured odometer source of each vehicle and adds an odometer record in LubeLogger when the value has increased.

device_id.name: Vehicles
device_id.description: Vehicles to sync. Leave empty to sync every vehicle that has a source configured.

add_odometer.name: Add odometer record
add_odometer.description: Adds an odometer record with an explicit value to LubeLogger.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Note for the record. Defaults to the configured note.

date.name: Date
date.description: Date of the record. Defaults to today.

get_reminders.name: Get reminders
get_reminders.description: Returns LubeLogger reminders grouped by vehicle and urgency, for use in notifications.

device_id.name: Vehicles
device_id.description: Vehicles to include. Leave empty for all vehicles.

urgencies.name: Urgencies
urgencies.description: Urgency levels to include. Defaults to past due, very urgent and urgent.

refresh.name: Refresh first
refresh.description: Fetch fresh data from LubeLogger before answering.
